Falcons have 2 issues. Degster brain and Kyxsan "300 iq calls" where he thinks more than needed (Especially on T side). 
But at the end of the day, they have a structure from Heroic that's being adapted to what Niko and Magisk bring to the table (Barely having to move roles on maps).

Falcons are not as bad as some people think they are. Their defeats this year are: 2 times against EF (Top 5 team right now) and close defeats against Pain (easy top 10 atm) and G2 (Also a new team that's not as bad as people want them to be).

This is a good test for both teams. I would be more surprised with Mouz winning despite having the better players overall.
